approve(address,uint256).details: Always reverts to enforce the SBT property.

balanceOf(address).details: Returns the number of tokens in ``owner``'s account.

delegateVoteTo(address).details: Caller must own a passport, not be a delegate themselves, not have already delegated,      and the target must be in delegated mode. Increments the target's delegatePower by 1.      Cannot be called while the contract is paused (voting period active).

params.to: The address of the representative to delegate to.

disableDelegatedMode().custom:note: Does not automatically revoke existing delegations from citizens who delegated to this address.
disableDelegatedMode().details: Caller must own a passport and currently be in delegated mode.      Cannot be called while the contract is paused (voting period active).

enableDelegatedMode().details: Caller must own a passport, not already be a delegate, and not have delegated their own vote.      Cannot be called while the contract is paused (voting period active).

getApproved(uint256).details: Returns the account approved for `tokenId` token. Requirements: - `tokenId` must exist.

returns.color: The color name associated with the citizen's passport image.

returns._0: The tokenURI string in the format `data:application/json;base64,<encoded JSON>`.
True if the address holds exactly one passport token.

isApprovedForAll(address,address).details: Returns if the `operator` is allowed to manage all of the assets of `owner`. See {setApprovalForAll}

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

ownerOf(uint256).details: Returns the owner of the `tokenId` token. Requirements: - `tokenId` must exist.

pauseDelegation(bool).details: Only callable by the owner (Orchestrator). Used to freeze delegation changes during voting.

params.b: True to pause, false to unpause.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

revokeDelegation().details: Caller must own a passport and currently have an active delegation.      Resets the caller's representative to address(0) and decrements the former      representative's delegatePower by 1. Cannot be called while paused (voting period active).

safeMint(address,string,string).details: Only callable by the owner (Orchestrator). Reverts if the recipient already holds a passport      or if image config has not been set. Pseudo-randomly selects an image from the IPFS folder      using block.timestamp, recipient address, and token ID as entropy.      Pseudo and nationality are validated to prevent JSON injection in tokenURI.

params.pseudo: Pseudo (max 32 characters, no `"` or `\` or control characters).
params.to: The address of the citizen receiving the passport.

returns._0: The token ID of the newly minted passport.

safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256.details: Safely transfers `tokenId` token from `from` to `to`, checking first that contract recipients are aware of the ERC-721 protocol to prevent tokens from being forever locked. Requirements: - `from` cannot be the zero address. - `to` cannot be the zero address. - `tokenId` token must exist and be owned by `from`. - If the caller is not `from`, it must have been allowed to move this token by either {approve} or   {setApprovalForAll}. - If `to` refers to a smart contract, it must implement {IERC721Receiver-onERC721Received}, which is called upon   a safe transfer. Emits a {Transfer} event.

Safely transfers `tokenId` token from `from` to `to`. Requirements: - `from` cannot be the zero address. - `to` cannot be the zero address. - `tokenId` token must exist and be owned by `from`. - If the caller is not `from`, it must be approved to move this token by either {approve} or {setApprovalForAll}. - If `to` refers to a smart contract, it must implement {IERC721Receiver-onERC721Received}, which is called upon   a safe transfer. Emits a {Transfer} event.

setApprovalForAll(address,bool).details: Always reverts to enforce the SBT property.

setImageConfig(string,string[]).details: Only callable by the owner. Must be called before the first mint.      Images must be named 1.svg, 2.svg, ... on IPFS.      The colors array must match the image count (index 0 → 1.svg, index 1 → 2.svg, ...).

params.imageColors: Array of color names in the same order as the images.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

tokenURI(uint256).details: JSON is generated fully on-chain and follows the OpenSea metadata standard.      The image field points to the IPFS folder set via setImageConfig, using the      pseudo-randomly assigned imageIndex stored at mint time.

params.tokenId: The ID of the passport token.

returns._0: A data URI string in the format `data:application/json;base64,<encoded JSON>`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Always reverts to enforce the SBT (Soulbound Token) property.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

approve(address,uint256).notice: Blocked. SixRPassport tokens are soulbound and cannot be approved for transfer.

constructor.notice: Initializes the ERC-721 token with name "6RVote" and symbol "6R".

delegateVoteTo(address).notice: Delegates the caller's vote to a representative citizen.

disableDelegatedMode().notice: Disables delegated mode for the caller, preventing them from receiving new delegations.

enableDelegatedMode().notice: Enables delegated mode for the caller, making them available to receive vote delegations.

getPassportAttributes(address).notice: Returns the passport attributes of a citizen from their address.

getTokenURI(address).notice: Returns the full tokenURI (Base64 JSON metadata) of a citizen from their address.

hasPassport(address).notice: Returns whether the given address holds a valid SixRPassport.

paused().notice: Whether the contract is currently paused. When true, all state-changing functions revert.

revokeDelegation().notice: Revokes the caller's active vote delegation.

s_delegatePowers(address).notice: Maps a delegate's address to the number of citizens who have delegated to them.         Each delegation increments this value; each revocation decrements it.

s_delegatedMode(address).notice: Indicates whether a citizen has enabled delegated mode (i.e., is accepting delegations).

s_representatives(address).notice: Maps a citizen's address to their chosen representative's address.         Set to address(0) when no delegation is active.

safeMint(address,string,string).notice: Mints a new passport SBT to the specified citizen address.

setApprovalForAll(address,bool).notice: Blocked. SixRPassport tokens are soulbound and cannot be approved for transfer.

setImageConfig(string,string[]).notice: Sets the base IPFS URI and color list for passport images.

tokenURI(uint256).notice: Returns the on-chain Base64-encoded JSON metadata URI for a given passport token.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).notice: Blocked. SixRPassport tokens are soulbound and cannot be transferred.
